"It's going great, fantastic," Fischer said of the summer. "It's an amazing experience coming in my rookie year and playing with so many great, experienced girls.
"I think that's what's so fantastic about water polo is that everyone goes way back and everyone's always so supportive and everyone's just so much fun to play with and it's so unrealistic that in a game situation you're basically playing on your own for the whole match."
